children: Tesla (TSLA) may invest $16.8B to build in-house chip production. Traders should note execution risks: chip yields, plant utilization, talent recruitment, manufacturing discipline and unit economics.
Barclays reports Giga Shanghai makes over half of Tesla's global vehicle output; exports equal nearly half of its production, marking the plant as a major driver of Tesla's volume and margins.
U.S. safety regulator ordered Tesla (TSLA) to respond by Sept. 30 on how it self-certified its autonomous driving design and whether vehicles can be driven using temporarily attached human controls
Tesla and SpaceX seek federal ruling that 'Terafab' doesn't infringe TERA-print as part of a planned $16.8B Texas chip fab for chips used in Optimus, Cybercabs, and SpaceX; TSLA shares fell ~1%.
Barclays forecasts Tesla (TSLA) will deliver 475,000 vehicles in Q3 vs Bloomberg’s 466,000. Barclays keeps Equal Weight and $370 target, noting FSD could boost margins amid AI-driven interest.
Goldman cut Tesla Q3 deliveries to 435,000, citing weaker U.S., China and Europe demand, partly offset by stronger sales in Southeast Asia, South America and Australia.
Tesla (TSLA) leverages fleet-generated AI data and in-house AI infrastructure as a data moat to advance general-purpose humanoid robotics, contrasting firms that rely on human-behavior datasets.
Tesla (TSLA) received approval to deploy its Full Self‑Driving system in Slovenia, the sixth EU country to authorize FSD, part of Tesla’s push to expand autonomous driving across Europe.
Tesla (TSLA) plans a new factory for its all-electric Semi and will give a near-term update on the Roadster, announced after this month’s Cybercab event.
Tesla (TSLA) will unveil the next‑gen Roadster on Oct 1 in Waco, Texas; reservation holders invited. Company says Roadster uses SpaceX-derived tech for significantly faster acceleration.
